items.title: Three California tribes launch prediction market apps powered by Kalshi, Bookmakers Review reports
items.content_text: - **Three California tribes launch prediction market apps powered by Kalshi, Bookmakers Review reports** — Bookmakers Review reports three California tribes are launching prediction market apps on Kalshi's exchange: Sovereign Edge from the Kletsel Dehe Wintun Nation, Greenville from the Greenville Rancheria, and AIR Markets from the Alturas Indian Rancheria.
